notes.title: Live in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We are very excited to make our app live in early access. 

The Early Access version of the app contains the following features: 

* 4 different "days", i.e. environments
* Bucks and boars coming in several waves of 3-6 animals per level
* Teleporting
* A rifle and a pistol

For the GA version of the game,

* We are certainly planning on adding more levels to the game. Right now, the following are on the top list: Snow, island, plains, mountains.
* The following animals are on the 'to integrate' list: rabbit, fox, elephant, lion, pig
* We will also be adding leaderboards so you can compete against your friend.

We'll be adding these (& more) in our next release. If you have something you'd like to see, please post in our forum or email us: founders@bouldervrstudios.com 


Thanks, 
Founders
Boulder VR Studios
